description: Manage authentication with the Microsoft Graph API. action=`status` (default) returns the current auth state and auto-refreshes the access token if it's expired but the refresh token is still valid (~90-day window) — call this first to check before other tools. action=`authenticate` starts the OAuth flow: with `method: "device-code"` (default, works headlessly) it returns a code + URL for the user to visit; with `method: "browser"` it opens the local auth server on :3333 (run `npm run auth-server` first). Pass `force: true` to re-authenticate over an existing valid session. action=`device-code-complete` finishes device-code auth after the user enters the code in their browser — call this once authentication shows as successful in the browser. action=`about` returns server version, configured audience, scope list, and other diagnostic info. Tokens persist to `~/.outlook-assistant-tokens.json` and survive server restarts.

force.description: Force re-authentication even if already authenticated (action=authenticate only)

method.description: Auth method for action=authenticate. device-code (default): no auth server needed, works remotely. browser: traditional OAuth redirect via port 3333.

name: auth
